Replace the anonymous class with a static nested subclass that holds the metadata in a transient field and falls back to the default lookup when it is null after deserialization.

Two non-serializable anonymous classes are stored in the serialized mock: the default answer ReturnsDeepStubs$2 captures the non-serializable GenericMetadataSupport, and the stubbing Answer created in recordDeepStubMock ($1) does not implement Serializable. Replace both with named serializable classes; the metadata one keeps the metadata in a transient field and falls back to the default lookup after deserialization.
